name: Full-Grain Leather Derby Shoe
description: A minimalist leather derby shoe in deep chestnut-brown with open lacing, a clean stitched welt, and a slim vulcanized rubber sole.
materials: smooth full-grain leather upper, stitched leather welt, slim vulcanized rubber sole
negativeConstraints: never render any text, logo, wordmark, emblem, or embossed/printed lettering anywhere on the shoe, including the inner sole edge; never add broguing or perforation; never render the leather as matte or heavily textured, it keeps a subtle genuine sheen
preservationNotes: keep the open derby lacing (quarters stitched on top of the vamp) and the slim low-profile rubber sole exactly as established across every angle; never thicken the sole into a chunky wedge; keep all leather surfaces entirely plain and unmarked
